item.title: Brantford blotter: Intimate partner violence; dangerous driving; impaired driving

item.description: Local teams picked up five medals, including one gold and four silvers last week at the Central Western Ontario Secondary Schools Association championships. item.title: Brant mayor loses one day's pay, encouraged to apologize for remarks
item.description: County of Brant Mayor David Bailey will lose one day's pay and is encouraged to apologize to two women who filed a complaint with the county's integrity commissioner.

item.title: Poppy Project brings community together to create public art piece

The Brantford Poppy Project’s inaugural workshop at the Thorpe Brothers Carriage House was packed with people of all ages who began to knit or crochet poppies.
